readme.summary: Well-structured intro with a clear quick-start example, but shallow on configuration details, advanced examples, and troubleshooting — and the README is for the parent @antv/g6 package, not the @antv/g6-core sub-package specifically.
readme.top_issue: No troubleshooting section at all, and the README doesn't explain what @antv/g6-core is vs @antv/g6 or when to use the core package directly.

common_complaints: Edge creation alignment and offset issues during interactive drawing
Node/tree layout positioning problems after version updates
Performance degradation with large numbers of edges
Display rendering issues with hierarchical/mind map layouts
sentiment.summary: Community shows moderate frustration with multiple recent unaddressed bugs and slow maintainer response (several issues marked 'waiting for maintainer' from March 2026), though engaged users provide detailed reports.

communication.summary: The maintainer responses are generally helpful and clear, showing patience with repeated questions and welcoming new contributors. They provide technical explanations where necessary but could offer more depth in some areas.

concerns: 330 open issues with zero closed in past 6 months

No open PRs indicates no incoming contributions being considered

positive_signals: Single recent commit on 2026-02-11 suggests not completely dormant
maintenance.summary: The package is effectively abandoned with a massive unresolved issue backlog and zero maintainer activity over the past 6 months.

changelog.summary: The changelog is well-categorized and appears comprehensive, but lacks clarity in marking breaking changes and providing migration guides.
